pages.title: Bosses
pages.text: Each of these bosses always drops its remnant, plus a 50% chance of $(item)oathboundrelics:oblivion_stone$().$(br2)$(li)Wither: $(item)oathboundrelics:colossus_heart$()$(li)Ender Dragon: $(item)oathboundrelics:ember_seed$()$(li)Elder Guardian: $(item)oathboundrelics:tide_pearl$()$(li)Warden: $(item)oathboundrelics:nebula_lens$()

pages.title: Mobs
pages.text: $(li)Phantoms: 10% chance of a $(item)oathboundrelics:skybrand_feather$(). Also rare loot in Woodland Mansions and End Cities.$(li)Shulkers: 5% chance of a $(item)oathboundrelics:void_pearl$(). Also rare loot in End Cities.
